podcast.body: Released in 1973, "48 Crash" was one of Suzi Quatro's hit songs during the glam era in the UK. This track exemplifies the sound that made her a major star across Europe and Australia. "This is from 1973, and it's called 48 Crash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
